explication: Box3D is a 3D physics engine for games. An application uses the public C API to define worlds, bodies, shapes, and constraints, then steps the world and consumes collision, sensor, and movement events or spatial-query results. Internally, world management coordinates broad-phase collision and solver work; recording and replay provide a separate capability. The README documents these product stages and capabilities, but most runtime implementations were not excerpted, so internal links are limited to relationships supported by the source index.
